title: Cosmic Tap Tycoon
core_loop: Player taps to generate cosmic energy, spends it on automated generators (probes, satellites, stations) that produce energy passively. Prestige system resets progress for permanent multipliers. Core loop: tap -> earn -> buy generators -> earn faster -> prestige -> repeat with multiplier.
controls: Click/tap anywhere on the main screen to generate energy manually. Click generator buttons to purchase/upgrade them. Click prestige button when available to reset for a permanent multiplier. All interactions are single-click/tap — no drag, hold, or complex gestures.
mechanics: Manual tap generates base energy (1 per tap, scaled by tap multiplier)
5 generator tiers: Probe (1 energy/sec), Satellite (8/sec), Station (60/sec), Mothership (500/sec), Dyson Array (5000/sec)
Each generator has individual level, cost scales exponentially (base * 1.15^level)
Bulk buy options: x1, x10, x100, max affordable
Prestige unlocks at 1,000,000 total energy earned; resets generators/energy, grants +1 Star Core (permanent +25% all production)
Star Cores also unlock cosmetic visual upgrades (background evolution, particle styles)
Offline progress: generators produce while closed (capped at 4 hours), shown on return
Achievement system: 20 milestones (total taps, generators owned, prestige count, time played) with small bonuses
Floating energy numbers on tap with color scaling by magnitude
No fail state — pure progression; session ends when player closes tab
juice: Tap ripple effect: expanding ring at click position, color matches current generator tier
Generator purchase: brief scale-up + color flash of button, coin burst particles
Energy counter: smooth count-up animation (lerp) when values change, not instant jump
Prestige sequence: screen whites out with expanding pulse, starfield reforms with new color palette
Background evolves with each prestige: empty space -> nebula -> star cluster -> galaxy -> cosmic web
Passive generator 'heartbeat': subtle pulse animation on owned generator icons at their production interval
Milestone popups: toast-style slide-in from top with icon, auto-dismiss after 3s
Offline progress report: animated counter rolling up to caught-up total on return
Tap multiplier visual: floating 'xN' badge near cursor that grows/shrinks with combo rhythm
Ambient particle drift: slow-moving cosmic dust in background, density increases with progression
mvp_scope: Single-screen idle clicker with 5 generator tiers, prestige system (Star Cores), offline progress, 20 achievements, and evolving cosmic background. All graphics procedural: generators as geometric icons (circles, triangles, hexagons), particles as colored circles, backgrounds as layered gradient + noise. No external assets. Web Audio API for subtle UI clicks and prestige chime. Responsive layout: generator list on left (desktop) / bottom drawer (mobile), main tap area center. Target 60fps on 5-year-old phones.
win_lose_condition: No lose condition — pure progression sandbox. Win condition per session: reach next prestige threshold or unlock next achievement. Long-term goal: unlock all 5 background evolutions (requires 4 prestiges) and earn 100 Star Cores. Game displays 'Session Progress' summary on close: energy earned, taps made, generators bought, time active.
